The '''Legends' Guild''' is the second most exclusive of the quest-based guilds in ''Old School RuneScape'' (with the [[Myths' Guild]] being the first). It is located to the north-east of [[East Ardougne]], east of [[Hemenster]], and the south of [[Seers' Village]]. To enter the grounds of the Legends' Guild, players must have started the [[Legends' Quest]]. However, to enter the actual building, players must have completed the entire quest. [[Radimus Erkle]] is the grand vizier of the guild, and he is also the start point of the Legends' Quest.

A [[Cape of Legends#Trivia|number of NPCs]] are implied to be members of the guild, by the fact they themselves wear a [[Cape of Legends]].

==Transportation==
There are several ways to get to the Legends' Guild:
*[[Quest point cape]] teleport - by the entrance
*[[Fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|BLR}} - just east of the entrance.
*[[Ardougne cloak]] (farm teleport) - run east.
*[[Myths' Guild]] - {{FloorNumber|uk=2}}, eastern red [[Portal of Legends]] - front path inside the guild.
*[[Wizards' Guild]] [[Yanille]] - {{FloorNumber|uk=2}}, western portal to the [[Sorcerer's Tower]], which is slightly to the north-west of the guild.
*[[Ardougne teleport]] - go east, then north.
*[[Combat bracelet]] to [[Ranging Guild]] - go south-east.
*[[Kandarin headgear 3]]/[[Kandarin headgear_4|4]] - teleport to [[Sherlock]] and run south.
*[[Camelot Teleport]] - go south-south-west.

==Guild==
<gallery>
File:Entrance of Legends' Guild.png|Entrance of the Legends' Guild

===Entrance===
At the gates of the Legend Guild, there are two [[Legends' Guard]]s on duty, only letting players who have started or completed the Legends' Quest go through the gates. If a player who is a member of the guild enters the gates the guards proclaim "Legends' guild member approaching!". A player who is currently doing the quest passing through the gates will result in the guards saying "Hope the quest is going well!".

===Outside===
Outside of the actual Legends Guild building is a small house where players can talk to [[Radimus Erkle]] and start the [[Legends' Quest]]. Opposite that is a fountain and the [[Golden Gnome]] statue.

==={{FloorNumber|uk=0|caps=y|nohelp=y}}===
[[Radimus Erkle]] stands on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}. There is also the [[Totem Pole (Legends' Guild)|totem pole]] which was obtained through the completion of the Legends' Quest. The [[skills necklace]] and [[combat bracelet]] can be recharged at the totem. Doing this is a requirement for the [[hard Ardougne Diary]]. He can also be used to collect excess quest experience after changes due to a Poll Change.<ref>{{PlainCiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=poll/oldschool/results?id=1650|title=Poll:Future Quests & Combat Achievement Rewards|newsdate=2 November 2022}}</ref>

===Dungeon===
Downstairs is a dungeon which has [[giant bat]]s, [[Pit Scorpion|pit scorpion]]s, and [[shadow warrior]]s.

A [[dwarf multicannon]] can be used.

==={{FloorNumber|uk=1|caps=y|nohelp=y}}===
Going up the stairs from the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}, on the next floor is [[Fionella]] who runs the [[Legends' Guild General Store]]. She will buy tradeable items from players at a higher price than normal general stores (slightly less than full high alchemy value that is offered by the best general stores).

==={{FloorNumber|uk=2|caps=y|nohelp=y}}===
Players can reach the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}} via a western and eastern ladder. Up the east ladder is a [[Legends' Guild bank|bank]]. Up the west ladder is [[Siegfried Erkle]], who runs the [[Legends Guild Shop of Useful Items]], which sells the [[shield right half]] and [[Cape of Legends]] amongst other items.
